label: A2BC4_oP28_62_ac_c_2cd-001
title: Ag$_{2}$CrO$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
(Santamaría-P\'{e}rez, 2013) find that above 4.5GPa there is a presumably second-order phase transition where the a axis contracts by about 4\%. 
 Above 13GPa they find a transition to an unknown structure. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC4D_oP28_62_c_a_2cd_c-002}{AgMnVO$_{4}$}, where manganese replaces silver on the (4a) site, is the quaternary form of this structure.
